title: fs2db migration is SQLite-only, so PostgreSQL URL normalization does not belong there
answers: does migrate-filestore support postgres as target
where is the filestore to database migration engine created
body:
mlflow/store/fs2db/cli.py rejects every non-SQLite target for migrate-filestore, so the CLI cannot reach a PostgreSQL engine.
mlflow/store/fs2db/__init__.py:migrate registers an unconditional SQLite-only PRAGMA listener on the engine, so a direct PostgreSQL call would be incompatible with it as well.
Because of this, adding postgresql+psycopg2 normalization in fs2db was unreachable for valid input and was reverted; the PostgreSQL driver concern for the filestore migration does not live in this module.
applies: Filestore-to-database migration code under mlflow/store/fs2db; revisit only if the CLI starts accepting PostgreSQL targets.
says: The filestore migration tool rejects connection strings for PostgreSQL target databases.
Allow migrating data from local file storage directly into a PostgreSQL database.
The database migration command fails when pointing to a remote PostgreSQL destination.
Support PostgreSQL destinations in the command line utility for migrating file store data.
Running the storage migration command against a PostgreSQL target shows an unsupported database error.
search: Filestore-to-database migration in mlflow/store/fs2db supports SQLite only, making PostgreSQL URL normalization unreachable. In mlflow/store/fs2db/cli.py, migrate-filestore rejects all non-SQLite target URLs, and mlflow/store/fs2db/__init__.py:migrate attaches an unconditional SQLite PRAGMA listener to the engine. PostgreSQL driver normalization (postgresql+psycopg2) was reverted from fs2db and should be reconsidered only if the CLI is modified to accept PostgreSQL targets.
